method: Fresh web_fetch of official Microsoft Learn during this West US 2 preparation.

observations: West US 2 has no row in either the supported Responses/Agents region table or the regional Function tool table. West US and West US 3 rows are distinct regions and cannot prove West US 2 support.
The page mentions West US 2 in the Grounding with Bing Search regional list, but that does not establish the required prompt-agent/Responses/Function configuration.
gpt-5.4-mini lists Functions Yes and Azure Functions No. The reference uses app-executed Functions, not Azure Functions.
Required West US 2 agent capabilities therefore remain unverified, not passed. No region, model or tool substitution made.
Managed Environment Count is a subscription/region quota, not a Consumption core quota.
Managed Environment Consumption Cores is environment-scoped and sums cores across active replicas of every app.
Default quotas vary by subscription; no default is assumed.
The documented az containerapp env list-usages check was executed against the exact proposed environment and failed ResourceGroupNotFound. No resource was created to discover the limit.
